description.en: Summarize finished tool calls and replace their raw output in later context.
description.zh-CN: 总结已完成的工具调用，在后续上下文中用摘要替换原始输出。

description.en: Show the prune footer status line and queued turn messages.
description.zh-CN: 显示底部的压缩状态行和排队的轮次消息。

description.en: When summarization and pruning run.
description.zh-CN: 何时执行总结与压缩。

description.en: One summary per assistant turn, or one per span between user messages.
description.zh-CN: 每个助手回合一份摘要，或在两次用户消息之间合并成一份。

description.en: "default" uses the active model; "provider/model-id" names another.
description.zh-CN: 填 default 用当前模型；也可以写 provider/model-id 指定别的模型。

description.en: Thinking level requested for summarizer calls.
description.zh-CN: 摘要调用使用的推理强度。

description.en: Suppress the notice when a batch is skipped as oversized or trivial.
description.zh-CN: 批次因过大或过小被跳过时不发提示。

description.en: Skip summarization below this many characters of raw output. 0 disables the guard.
description.zh-CN: 原始输出少于这个字数就不总结。0 表示不设门槛。

description.en: User turns a recovered output stays verbatim before it reverts to a stub. 0 reverts at once.
description.zh-CN: 取回的内容原样保留几个用户轮次，之后重新变回占位符。0 表示立即变回。

description.en: Abort a summarizer stream that goes quiet for this long. 0 disables the timer.
description.zh-CN: 摘要流静默超过这个时间就中止。0 表示不计时。

description.en: Hard ceiling for one summarizer call. 0 disables the ceiling.
description.zh-CN: 单次摘要调用的总时长上限。0 表示不限。

description.en: Tool names whose output is never pruned.
description.zh-CN: 这些工具的输出永远不会被压缩。

description.en: Glob patterns whose files are never pruned.
description.zh-CN: 匹配这些 glob 的文件内容永远不会被压缩。

description.en: Treat identical tool output as one batch entry.
description.zh-CN: 把内容完全相同的工具输出当作同一条。

description.en: Collapse finished tool-call chains into their final summary.
description.zh-CN: 把已经结束的工具调用链合并成最终摘要。

description.en: Recent chains kept available for chain compression.
description.zh-CN: 保留多少个最近的调用链可供压缩。

description.en: Minutes a chain may stay open before it is cleaned up. 0 disables cleanup.
description.zh-CN: 调用链闲置多少分钟后清理。0 表示不清理。

description.en: Remove the final assistant's thinking from a compressed chain.
description.zh-CN: 压缩调用链时去掉最后一条助手消息里的思考内容。

description.en: Let range compression reuse a chain summary instead of summarizing again.
description.zh-CN: 区间压缩时复用已有的链摘要，不重复总结。

description.en: Drop repeated failing tool calls' arguments from later context.
description.zh-CN: 把失败工具调用的重复参数从后续上下文中移除。

description.en: Turns before a failing call is purged again.
description.zh-CN: 失败的调用再次被清理前要等的轮数。

description.en: Only purge failing calls whose arguments are at least this long.
description.zh-CN: 只清理参数长度不低于这个值的失败调用。

description.en: Flush when the context reaches this fraction of the window. Empty disables it.
description.zh-CN: 上下文达到窗口的这个比例时提前压缩。留空表示不启用。

description.en: Output larger than this is spilled to a file with a preview left in context.
description.zh-CN: 超过这个大小的输出会溢出到文件，上下文中只保留预览。

description.en: How much of a spilled output stays in context.
description.zh-CN: 溢出后仍在上下文中保留多少内容。

description.en: Context growth per turn that counts as normal. Empty uses the default rule.
description.zh-CN: 每轮正常的上下文增长量。留空表示使用默认规则。

description.en: Token gap that triggers frontier pruning. Empty uses the default.
description.zh-CN: 触发前沿压缩的 token 间隔。留空表示使用默认值。

description.en: How many images one request may carry. Empty leaves them untouched.
description.zh-CN: 单次请求最多携带多少张图片。留空表示不处理。
